```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 18)) #for ggplot

```

```{r}
dac <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "Dactylis_Demography_Data_CLEANED_2016thru2026.csv"))
climate <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "CGOP_climatevalues_scaled.csv"))
climate<- climate %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~lag(.x), .names = "prev_{.col}"))# %>% 
  #select(c(year, winter.mean.min.temp, prev_winter.mean.min.temp, summer.mean.max.temp, prev_summer.mean.max.temp, spring.mean.temp, prev_spring.mean.temp, fall.mean.temp, prev_fall.mean.temp, ends_with("tot.precip")))

dac <- left_join(dac, climate, by = c("Year" = "year"))
dac <- dac %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year), 
         Plot = as.factor(Plot),
         survT = as.factor(survT),
         survT1 = as.factor(survT1),
         pflowerT = as.factor(pflowerT),
         pflowerT1 = as.factor(pflowerT1),
         log.no.stems = log(No.stems),
         log.no.stemsT1 = log(No.stemsT1),
        trt = as.factor(trt),
        trt = fct_relevel(trt, "irrigated", "control", "drought"))

dac <- dac %>% 
  filter(!(Plot %in% c("4", "5", "15")))

dac.surv <- dac %>% 
  filter(!Year =="2026",
  !is.na(survT1)) 
```

```{r ground truthing lambda}
lam <- dac %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%
  group_by(Year, Plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(survT == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Plot, Year) %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda.plot = lead(n) / n,
    lambda.plot = na_if(lambda.plot, NaN)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

lam.all <- dac %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(survT == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = lead(n) / n
  )
  
(lambda <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = lambda.plot, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1)+
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(lambda)) +
  theme_minimal())
(n <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = n, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of plants") +
  theme_minimal())
(n.size <- 
  lam.all %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of plants") +
  theme_minimal())

(lambda.size <- ggplot(lam.all, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = lambda, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1)+
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(lambda)) +
  theme_minimal())

(to.plot <- lambda/n +plot_layout(guides = "collect")
)
ggsave(here("Figures", "Dactylis", "groundtruth.lambda.perplot.png"), plot = to.plot, width = 8, height =6)

(to <- lambda.size/n.size +plot_layout(guides = "collect")
)

ggsave(here("Figures", "Dactylis", "groundtruth.lambda.png"), plot = to, width = 8, height =6)

```

```{r what size metric to use, and for pflower}
#whats a better size measurement - log(no.stems *height) or log(no.stems)?
dac_size_complete <- dac %>%
  arrange(Plot, Year) %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
  mutate(
    log_stem_height = log(No.stems * Height),
    log_stem_height_lag = lag(log_stem_height)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(
    complete.cases(
      log_stem_height,
      log_stem_height_lag,
      log.no.stems,
      log.no.stemsT1,
      Plot
    )
  )
#dac_size_complete <- dac[complete.cases(dac[, c("log_stem_height", "log_stem_height_lag", "log.no.stems", "log.no.stemsT1", "Plot")]), ]

size.test1 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac_size_complete, REML = F)

size.test2 <- lmer(log_stem_height_lag ~ log_stem_height + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = dac_size_complete, REML = F)
AIC(size.test1, size.test2)
#first one

#size in current year or past year for flowering
dac_complete <- dac[complete.cases(dac[, c("pflowerT", "pflowerT1", "log.no.stems", "Year", "Plot")]), ]
f.test1  <- glmer(pflowerT ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = dac_complete, family = "binomial")
f.test2  <- glmer(pflowerT1 ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = dac_complete, family = "binomial")
AIC(f.test1, f.test2) #one is better

table(dac$survT1, dac$Year)
table(dac$pflowerT, dac$Year)
table(dac$stage, dac$Year)
table(dac$No.panicles, dac$Year)

summary_df <- dac %>%
  group_by(Plot, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    panciles_t = sum(No.panicles, na.rm = TRUE),
    seedlings_t = sum(stage=="seedling", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
summary_df
t_t1_table <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(seedlings_t1 = lead(seedlings_t)) %>% 
  mutate(seedlings_per_panicle = ifelse(
    panciles_t == 0 | is.na(panciles_t) | is.na(seedlings_t1),
    NA,
    seedlings_t1 / panciles_t
  ))
mean_seedlings_per_panicle <- mean(
  t_t1_table$seedlings_per_panicle,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
sd_seedlings_per_panicle <- sd(
  t_t1_table$seedlings_per_panicle,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
median_seedlings_per_panicle <- median(
  t_t1_table$seedlings_per_panicle,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
#0.096
#0.095 after 2026
```

```{r growth prequel}
base <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems*Year + (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)
drop1(base,test="Chisq")
base2 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+Year + (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)
base3 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)
a2 <- anova(base3, base2, test="LRT") #yes year is significant
best.growth <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems + (1|Year) + (1|Plot), data = dac, REML = F)

re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(best.growth)$Year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

# 
grow.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)
names(grow.corr)[names(grow.corr) == "(Intercept)"] <- "int"
cor_matrix <- cor(grow.corr)
correlations <- cor_matrix[,"int"]

correlations <- correlations[names(correlations) != "int"]
correlations_sorted <- sort(correlations, decreasing = TRUE)
###
vars <- names(grow.corr)[names(grow.corr) != "int"]

# Compute correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(grow.corr$int, grow.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into one data frame
cor_results_growth <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results_growth <- cor_results_growth[order(-abs(cor_results_growth$correlation)), ]
#summer tot.precip only with with correlation
```

overdisp_fun <- function(model) {
  rdf <- df.residual(model)
  rp <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
  Pearson.chisq <- sum(rp^2)
  prat <- Pearson.chisq / rdf
  pval <- pchisq(Pearson.chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = FALSE)

  c(
    chisq = Pearson.chisq,
    ratio = prat,
    rdf = rdf,
    p = pval
  )
}
overdisp_fun(poisson.sp.wt.int2)

#   theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.1))+
#   geom_abline(slope=1, intercept = 0, color= "grey", linewidth = .2)+
#   scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5))+
#   scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5))+
#   labs( x = "log(Number of Stems) in t", y = "log(Number of Stems) in t + 1"))

(pan.sp <- dac %>% 
    filter(pflowerT == "1") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log.no.stems, y = No.panicles))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25, shape = 1, height = .05, width = 0.05)+
  geom_line(data = subset(pred.dat.output.pan, prev_winter.tot.precip == 0 & prev_spring.mean.temp != 0), aes(y = No.panicles, color = factor(prev_spring.mean.temp)),linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.1), legend.position = c(0.25, 0.8),   legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA))+   scale_color_manual(name = "Spring temp, t-1", values = c("#00a3a3","#d72a96"), labels = c("cool", "warm")) +
  #scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5.25))+
  #scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5.25))+
  labs(x = "log(Number of Stems) in t", y = "Number of panicles in t"))

(pan.wp <- dac %>% 
    filter(pflowerT == "1") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log.no.stems, y = No.panicles))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.25, shape = 1, height = .05, width = 0.05)+
  geom_line(data = subset(pred.dat.output.pan, prev_spring.mean.temp == 0 &  prev_winter.tot.precip!= 0), aes(y = No.panicles, color = factor(prev_winter.tot.precip)), linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.1), legend.position = c(0.25, 0.8),   legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
  legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA))+   
  scale_color_manual(name = "Winter precip, t-1", values = c("#a30031", "#0c74ce"), labels = c("dry", "wet")) +
  #scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5.25))+
  #scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-.25, 5.25))+
  labs(x = "log(Number of Stems) in t", y = "Number of panicles in t"))


(pan.fig <- pan.sp+pan.wp +  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'i') + plot_layout(axes = "collect")
)
ggsave(here("Figures", "Dactylis", "pan.png"), plot = pan.fig, width = 10, height =6)
